english.title: Make a incorrect claim for a drawback / allowance / remission / rebate / repayment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a claim for

(A)_[drawback]_
(B)_[allowance]_
(C)_[remission]_
(D)_[repayment]_

of duty in respect of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), having been made and it being found that the goods did not correspond with the declaration made thereof in respect of that claim, you were the person who in respect of that claim

(H)_[the declaration]_
(I)_[the claim]_

had been made
english.legislation: Contrary to section 136(4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
in the case of goods upon which a claim for drawback, allowance, remission or repayment of duty has been made
and it being found that the goods do not correspond with a declaration made thereof in respect of that claim
is the person by whom such a declaration or claim is made

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 136(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provide that the goods shall be liable to forfeiture.
(ii) This offence applies in the case of any goods upon which a claim for drawback, allowance, remission or repayment of duty has been made where it has been found that the goods, if sold for home use, would realise less than the amount claimed as it applies where the finding specified in that subsection is made except that it does not apply by virtue of this subsection to any claim under
(a) section 123 or 134(2) of the Act; or
(B) section 46, 61 or 64 of the Alcoholic Liquor Duties Act 1979 (remission or repayment of duties on certain spoilt liquors).
(iii) For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H10736 (CJS code CE79312).

other.penalty:
Summary: A penalty of three times the amount which was or might have been improperly obtained or allowed or level three on the standard scale whichever is the greater.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex
